newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras Jan net above expectations - Bear Stearns.
newsitem.headline: Telebras Jan net above expectations - Bear Stearns.

text.p: Bear Stearns & Co said January earnings for Brazilian telecom giant Telebras were stronger than expected, but February and March results should suffer from inflation-related rate erosion.

Telebras this week announced unaudited one-month earnings equal to $0.83 per American Depositary Share (ADS), "which on a quarterly basis would be 30 percent above our estimate for 1Q97," the brokerage said in a report.
It also said a recent rate hike should begin "making a net positive impact" on Telebras' results around mid-year.
"Telebras is on a trajectory to meet, if not surpass, our $9.70 per ADS full-year 1997 earnings forecast," it added.
Bear Stearns said it is maintaining its forecast as well as its strong buy recommendation on Telebras shares.

It also said unaudited January earnings of $1.51 per preferred share at Telebras' Telesp unit were in line with market expectations and the firm is one target to meet the brokerage's annual estimate of $18.55.
"Accordingly, we maintain our attractive recommendation for Telesp with a year-end $355 per preferred share price target," the report said.
